blockTypes.meaning: thin strip above the header with a promo, shipping threshold or notice
logo, main menu, search, account and cart icons
the large opening banner of a page: headline, image or video, primary call to action
row of short selling points with icons (free shipping, returns, guarantees)
row of press, retailer or partner logos ("as seen in")
one image beside or behind a block of copy, a single story or feature
a section whose main content is a video player or video embed
grid or list of product or brand features, benefits or ingredients
customer quotes or written endorsements (not the product reviews widget)
grid or carousel of customer photos or social posts (Instagram, TikTok)
questions and answers, usually an accordion
email or SMS sign-up form
short band whose job is one call to action
site footer: link columns, legal, payment icons, social links
table comparing products, plans or the brand against competitors
plans or tiers with prices to choose between (not a single product's buy box)
people: founders, team members, experts
cards linking to articles, journal or blog posts
contact details or a contact form
large numbers as proof ("1M customers", "4.8 stars")
numbered steps or a timeline explaining a process
promotion of a mobile app with store badges
certification, security, payment or guarantee badges
a curated row or carousel of products on a home or landing page
the main product grid of a collection or category page, or a grid of collection tiles
a single product tile, or a section that is essentially one product card
filters, facets and sort controls for a product listing
a product page's image gallery and thumbnails
product title, price, variants and add to cart
choice between one-time purchase and subscribe (and save), delivery frequency
build-your-own bundle or kit: pick several items for a set price
size chart, fit guide or measurement help
shipping, delivery and returns information
product details in tabs or accordions (description, ingredients, how to use)
the reviews widget: star summary, review list, write a review
"you may also like", "complete the look", frequently bought together
products the shopper viewed before
add-to-cart bar fixed to the top or bottom while scrolling
slide-out mini cart
the cart page's line items, totals and checkout button
a checkout step: contact, shipping, payment
thank-you or order status page content
login, register or account dashboard
results of an on-site search
a quiz or finder that recommends products
find a physical store or stockist
gift card purchase or balance

pageRoles.meaning: the first thing a visitor sees: top of the page, in the first screen
site chrome that repeats on every page: announcement bar, header, menus
the body of the page: what this page is about
where the page asks for the purchase or sign-up: buy box, pricing, add to cart, sign-up
reviews, testimonials, press, stats and badges that build trust
end of the page: final call to action, footer
